tasks.short: Determine circuit current requirements from the actual PV electrical design.

steps.what: Select the actual design revision and verify module, inverter and circuit specifications
Examine the circuit topology and identify applicable current requirements for every component
Calculate current requirements using checked topology, ratings and applicable design factors
Check computed currents against source ratings and judge design exceptions
Write and check final current requirements, design references and unresolved limits
Save the checked circuit current requirement note

tasks.design: Use existing native circuit calculation in {OTHER}, the PV electrical design application, after the installer verifies actual topology, ratings and applicable factors. Keep design examination, engineering exceptions and substantive requirement writing human; save the checked result separately in {DOCS} without releasing a design or changing equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated current arithmetic may be performed separately from source design examination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native design calculators can repeat explicit verified formulas without a model interpreting electrical requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Correct topology, source ratings and applicability of design factors need competent judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The installer detects when a mathematically consistent result does not fit the actual circuit.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic; electrical authority is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: PV electrical design applications can calculate circuit currents from explicit ratings and topology.

assumptions: Boundary is examining an existing design and documenting current requirements. Physical installation and formal design release are not performed here.

The designer and manufacturers supply revision, component IDs, ratings and topology. The installer captures and verifies circuit grouping, parallel paths, units and selected design factors in s1 and s2. Missing or ambiguous inputs return to manual source checking before calculation.
Native calculation is tested first. Shares and reduction are provisional; existing automatic arithmetic earns no benefit. Calculation runtime is not baseline human effort.
The final note check is ordinary accuracy work, not extra approval ceremony. The separate fully retained 1 percent save is schema granularity.
unknowns: Installer authority for this design review
research_questions: Can the native calculator reproduce independently checked representative circuit requirements?

incremental.description: Check formula settings and component-library revisions

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked current requirement note for the actual circuit design revision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional repeated current calculation saves 25 points minus two upkeep = 23. Half eligible calculations gives 12.5 minus two = 10.5. Design examination, actual input checking, exception judgement, writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose PV layout, orientation and mounting methods suitable for the actual site.

steps.what: Examine actual roof geometry, access, shading and mounting constraints
Plot candidate module arrangements and orientation variants from checked dimensions
Identify layout, orientation and mounting methods balancing installation, electrical configuration and future maintenance
Write and check selected methods, actual constraints and specialist questions on the layout
Save the checked layout method note

tasks.design: Configure native array-copy and orientation tools in {OTHER}, the PV layout application, for installer-selected candidate arrangements. Retain actual site examination, all mounting-method judgement and substantive rationale writing; the checked {DOCS} note is saved separately and does not authorise physical mounting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated layout placement can consume time without changing the actual method choice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native layout variants can reuse checked dimensions while leaving method selection with the installer.
tasks.still_hard: Access, roof conditions and serviceability are only partly represented in a drawing.
tasks.human_edge: The installer relates a candidate layout to real installation and future maintenance constraints.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated drawing; installation and design authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: PV layout applications support repeated module placement and orientation variants from dimensional inputs.

assumptions: Boundary is identifying methods and documenting their rationale, not mounting modules or providing structural certification.

The site assessor supplies measured dimensions and obstacles; the installer checks actual access, shading context and mounting constraints in s1 and enters missing drawing dimensions in s2, whose retained effort counts that entry.
No model infers roof condition or safe mounting. Native array tools are tested first; already configured repeated placement earns no new benefit.
Provisional shares are not measured. The existing final note check covers its save; the fully retained 1 percent save is schema granularity.
research_questions: Which repeated placements can native tools remove while retaining actual site and maintenance judgement?

incremental.description: Check module dimensions and mounting template revisions

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked layout method note and actual constraint references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional native drawing placement reduces 15 units by half, saving 7.5 points minus one upkeep = 6.5. Half eligible placement gives 2.75. Site examination, method choice, actual writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine interfaces to subpanels, utility services or other generation sources.

steps.what: Examine the actual existing installation, proposed PV connection and source interface requirements
Find current interface specifications for the exact subpanel, inverter and generation equipment
Evaluate electrical compatibility, protection boundaries and requirements for the actual connection
Determine the connection interface and identify questions requiring authorised specialist confirmation
Write and check interface references, constraints and unresolved specialist questions
Save the checked connection interface note

tasks.design: Configure equipment-ID and revision filters in the existing {DOCS} technical library to locate exact interface sources. Retain physical examination, source reading, compatibility judgement and actual determination writing; save the checked note separately without making a utility submission or energising a connection.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exact interface documents can be buried among similar equipment variants.
tasks.enabler_now: Native equipment and revision filters can shorten navigation without deciding compatibility.
tasks.still_hard: Existing installation condition, protective arrangements and utility constraints need competent interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The installer recognises when the actual installation differs from the drawings or exceeds their authority.
tasks.altitude: Less document finding; electrical connection authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document libraries support equipment identifiers and revision filters for technical source retrieval.

assumptions: Boundary is determining interfaces and writing their references, not physically connecting or submitting a utility application.

Manufacturers and the utility supply actual controlled documents; the installer verifies equipment identities and actual site context in s1. No extracted compatibility flags are assumed; missing metadata requires manual search in s2.
All source reading, electrical judgement and fresh writing retain full effort. Native filters are tested first and existing filters earn no new benefit.
Shares are provisional. The final note check is existing accuracy work and covers the separate fully retained save; its 1 percent is schema granularity.
unknowns: Current utility and equipment document access
research_questions: Do native filters distinguish exact equipment variants and applicable revisions?

incremental.description: Maintain equipment document metadata and inspect broken source links

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked actual connection interface note and source revisions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional exact document finding reduces 15 units by 50 percent, saving 7.5 minus one upkeep = 6.5. Half eligible retrieval gives 2.75. Actual examination, source reading, interface judgement, writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose PV designs or configurations for customer needs and actual site conditions.

steps.what: Clarify actual customer needs, expectations, priorities and design constraints
Assess actual site conditions and capture checked dimensions, demands and configuration constraints
Prepare candidate configurations and native yield scenarios from the checked design inputs
Determine the configuration that fits customer priorities, actual conditions and technical limitations
Write and check the configuration rationale, assumptions and unresolved customer or technical questions
Save the checked PV configuration record

tasks.design: Use native parameter reuse and scenario comparison in {OTHER}, the PV design application, after actual customer and site input capture. Keep customer discovery, site assessment, configuration choice and substantive rationale writing human; the checked {DOCS} record is saved separately and does not send a customer offer or authorise construction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparing comparable candidate configurations may repeat the same measured inputs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scenario tools can reuse actual dimensions and component data while retaining human choice.
tasks.still_hard: Predicted yield and technical feasibility do not determine the customers real priorities.
tasks.human_edge: The installer weighs practical compromises and explains limits against actual customer expectations.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive scenario preparation; configuration judgement and authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: PV design applications support configuration variants and yield scenarios using explicit site and component parameters.

assumptions: Boundary is determining a configuration and its rationale. Customer approval, offer dispatch, engineering release and installation are distinct workflows and are not represented as completed.

The installer captures customer priorities, measured usable area, orientation, obstructions, demand context and constraints in s2; manufacturer data supplies component ratings. Missing data requires manual entry or further assessment counted in s2 and retained s3 time.
Only repeated input and scenario preparation changes, not software simulation runtime. Native configuration is tested first; already reused inputs earn no benefit.
Shares and reduction are provisional. The actual final record check covers the save; its fully retained 1 percent action is schema granularity.
unknowns: Quality of site measurements and demand evidence
research_questions: Can the native scenario tool reuse verified inputs without hiding changed assumptions?

incremental.description: Check scenario defaults and component data changes

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked configuration record with actual input and scenario assumptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional scenario preparation reduces 20 units by 50 percent, saving ten points minus 1.5 upkeep = 8.5. Half eligible repetition gives five minus 1.5 = 3.5. Customer discovery, site capture, actual choice, writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
